title: HTX publishes Simple Earn Agreement
description: HTX published the Simple Earn Agreement governing purchases and redemptions of HTX Earn products, including flexible and fixed-term products.
notes: This is a documented agreement-publication milestone, not an asserted original product launch date.

title: HTX Earn Flexible promotion confirms current operation
description: HTX announced a Flexible Earn promotion and documented hourly accrual, compounding and redemption mechanics, confirming continuing Simple Earn/Flexible operation in 2026.
notes: Current-operation evidence, not a launch event.

title: CoinEx continues to document the Financial Account name
description: A CoinEx announcement adding assets to its yield product still called the product Financial Account and described interest distribution from borrowed coins in margin trading.
notes: This establishes the predecessor name immediately before Flexible Savings documentation appeared; it is not a closure event.

title: CoinEx announces Flexible Savings product upgrade
description: CoinEx announced an upgrade to its Flexible Savings product with a tiered subsidy structure and documented current flexible subscription, redemption and borrowing-linked yield mechanics.
notes: The exact formal rename date from Financial Account to Flexible Savings remains unresolved.
